tasks.test: deno test -A packages/core packages/service packages/server packages/cli packages/web/src scripts site
tasks.check: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint && deno task typecheck && deno run -A scripts/check_headers.ts && deno run -A scripts/check_portability.ts && deno run -A scripts/check_licenses.ts && deno task test
tasks.typecheck: deno check packages/core packages/service packages/server packages/cli packages/web scripts site e2e acceptance packages/cloudflare/scripts
tasks.build: deno task build:web && deno task build:server
tasks.docker:smoke: deno task docker && deno run -A scripts/docker_smoke.ts
tasks.site:preview: deno task site:build && cd site && vite preview
tasks.cf:build: cd packages/cloudflare && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist --env production --containers-rollout none
tasks.cf:check: cd packages/cloudflare && wrangler types --strict-vars false --check && tsc --noEmit && cd ../.. && deno task cf:fixtures --check && deno task cf:test && deno task cf:build
tasks.acceptance: deno task build:cli && deno run -A scripts/acceptance.ts
tasks.workflow: deno task build:cli && deno run -A scripts/workflow.ts
tasks.docker:workflow: deno task build:cli && deno run -A scripts/docker_workflow.ts
